description: Live availability of public EV charging points in Switzerland (official SFOE feed, minutes old): national and per-canton availability and fast chargers; with place (postcode or locality) or lat/lon also the nearest points within km with their live status. No prices (no official register exists).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 46.95 (with lon).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 7.44 (with lat).

place.description: Swiss place: postcode, locality or both, e.g. "8001", "Basel", "8001 Zürich" or "Basel (BS)". Alternatively give lat and lon. Omit place and coordinates for the national and per-canton summary.

name: ev_charging_near
title: EV charging availability
